items.title: Albert Burbank Interview, 1959-03-18
items.q: Or how old you were when you played with Buddy? ... I think that should have been somewhere around between 25 and 30.

ctx.x: When did Yang die about, do you know? I never knew him or his brother.
Did he live longer than Buddy Johnson? Oh yeah. Yeah.
Buddy was dead a good while before him.
